name: Side anchor: play the model's side every game
rule_verbatim: one unit on the published home spread for every originated game

name: Total anchor: side of the league scoring baseline
rule_verbatim: over when the model total exceeds the league-average total at the vintage, under otherwise

name: Moneyline anchor: play the model's favourite
rule_verbatim: one unit on whichever club the published moneyline favours

name: Damped side at lambda 0.60 with a 3.0-point floor
rule_verbatim: shrink the projection first, then bet only when the damped margin still clears 3.0 points

name: Movement follower: open to close inside the store
rule_verbatim: bet the direction our own number moved between its first and last snapshot before kickoff
blocked_reason: a same-model second snapshot is needed; the store began 2026-11-14, so the first week the daily runner closes is the first week this can be graded

name: Depth override: injury tiers dropped against the scoring-rate line
rule_verbatim: penalise a club's expected margin by 0.75 points per tier dropped on the official report and bet only when the penalty flips the side

name: Two-game same-week side parlay
rule_verbatim: the two largest absolute model margins of a week, one unit as a two-leg ticket

name: Same-game side plus over parlay (SGP)
rule_verbatim: when the model margin is positive for the home club and the model total exceeds the league baseline, a two-leg ticket on home side and over

name: Market-edge side: bet when the fair line beats the book
rule_verbatim: needs a market line to difference against
blocked_reason: no official or licensed market price exists in this environment (flag D966-F01); the rule stays in the catalogue so the gate has something to refuse

name: Player-prop combo, three legs
rule_verbatim: needs official per-player game statistics to settle
blocked_reason: per-player statistics were not read in this session (flag D966-F06); no prop leg is settled by inference
